ideas.name: the last hour moved its way by 2 five-minute ATRs
ideas.why: momentum: an hour of one-way flow is an order being worked; the breakout is its next leg

ideas.name: the last 5 sessions closed up (long) / down (short)
ideas.why: the week's trend's holders buy (sell) intraday breakouts its way

ideas.name: yesterday was an inside day
ideas.why: compression before expansion: a day inside the one before leaves orders stacked at both edges

ideas.name: yesterday was the narrowest of 7 (NR7)
ideas.why: the classic volatility-contraction setup: the narrowest day is followed by a range day

ideas.name: beyond the last 5 sessions' high (long) / low (short)
ideas.why: a break of the week's range triggers the week's stops and swing traders' entries

ideas.name: the signal bar closes in its top (long) / bottom (short) fifth
ideas.why: conviction: buyers held the high into the close; a breakout bar that closes off its high is already being sold

ideas.name: 1m RSI not stretched (below 75 long / above 25 short)
ideas.why: a breakout already overbought is the late buyers; the next push has no one left

ideas.name: the day's first breakout its way
ideas.why: the first break of the day takes the overnight orders; later ones are repeats into a known level
